business_problem: Finhike needed a cloud platform that could keep a lending stack fast and available in unstable connectivity environments, power real-time risk decisions, and let the team launch country-specific services with minimal lead time.
solution_summary: Finhike uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Finhike needed a cloud platform that could keep a lending stack fast and available in unstable connectivity environments, power real-time risk decisions, and let the team launch country-specific services with minimal lead time. Compute Engine runs the proprietary risk engine that evaluates diverse data pools for real-time lending decisions, serving as the compute layer. BigQuery consolidates Google Analytics and conversion data for marketing and performance reporting, serving as the storage layer. Gemini improves engineering productivity by assisting with coding and database-management tasks, serving as the compute layer. Cloud Logging provides minute-by-minute operational visibility for compliance and reliability monitoring, serving as the governance layer. Cloud Monitoring helps the team resolve issues in minutes and maintain regulator-facing reporting reliability, serving as the governance layer.
